package.description: AI-native shell environment with semantic command review

en-US.description: AI-native shell environment with semantic command review
en-US.longDescription: CommandUI is a desktop shell that combines a real terminal with AI-powered semantic input. Describe intent in natural language, review generated commands before execution, and build reusable workflows. Built with Tauri v2, React 19, and Ollama for local-first AI planning.
en-US.name: CommandUI
en-US.releaseNotes:
CommandUI 1.0.2 is the functional update: a Windows shell where every command ends in one plain sentence, you can ask for a command in plain words, and nothing runs until you approve it.
This release makes no claim of tested accessibility. Testing with Narrator, NVDA and Windows contrast themes comes in a later update.
What's new
- Every result ends in a plain sentence. A failure offers Ask how to fix it and Run again.
- Output (Ctrl+Shift+O) lists each command as plain text, one region per command.
- Results are announced once; errors are announced as alerts.
- A keyboard path for every action. F1 lists the shortcuts.
- Text size from 100% to 200%, and panels you can hide.
- A welcome screen on first open, and a new logo.
- Workflows you can create, edit, run and undo.
- The first Ask after opening waits while the local model loads, and says so.
- Your home folder is shown as ~, so your account name stays off the screen.
Full list: CHANGELOG.

Download
- CommandUI_1.0.2_x64_en-US.msi or CommandUI_1.0.2_x64-setup.exe: Windows 10 or 11, x64. They are not code-signed, so Windows may ask you to confirm before it installs them.
- CommandUI_1.0.2_x64.msix is the unsigned Store package; install CommandUI from the Microsoft Store once the update clears certification.
Ask needs Ollama on the same computer with the qwen2.5:14b model. Everything else works without it.
